title: With ChatGPT 5.5 you can create a week worth of content EASY!! Watch this! #chatgpt #chatgptprompt
description: With ChatGPT 5.5 you can create a week worth of content EASY!! Watch this! #chatgpt #chatgptprompt #ai #aitips #learnai
transcript: Chat GPT 5.5 just came out this week, and if you use this one prompt and image 2.0, you can create a week's worth of content in 30 seconds. Watch this. When I come into Chat GPT, make sure that you're using thinking mode, and then put in your prompt that you want to go make content for Instagram, that you want seven individual posts, then press send. Then once the seven ideas are done, just come down here and turn on image mode, then say, "Now here's my website. Please use my website for branding guidance and create those seven photos." Then paste your website link. Then it will grab your branding assets and go create all of the posts for you.
